verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is an open-source, client-side 3D rendering and game engine library (Apache-2.0 npm packages) that runs inside the developer's own application. User data retention and deletion controls are a hosted-service privacy axis that does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product offering data-retention or deletion capabilities that would make the axis apply, and the hosted Playground's sharing feature is not evidenced as carrying any retention controls.
